name: Cannellini Bean Salad
author: carl-zimmerman on based.cooking

ingredients.item: 1 can Cannellini beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Sauté garlic and onions in olive oil until onions are translucent.
Add diced tomatoes, seasonings, and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the beans, season to taste, mix until combined, and simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve over arugula and top with bits of prosciutto.

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
